# Component inventory

29 client-owned component files (the purpose folders in tenants.config.json → componentOwners), grouped into shapes by what they are. The right-hand column is the catalog type a new answer of that shape should use (the gap ladder: pick, extend, compose, then create). Existing bespoke components stay drawable as tier-4 types until each is promoted into one of these or retired.
